protocol.purpose: Learn weights daily and seek high win rate subject to positive net expectancy, profit factor, sample size and drawdown constraints. No guarantee that any model passes.
protocol.trailRule: Only after completed5m profit>=1R move stop toward fee-inclusive breakeven; after>=1.5R use2ATR5m trail; exit on completed15m EMA8/21 reversal. No fixed target for trail profile.
protocol.carryRule: At14:55/02:25, conditional mode holds only if causal15/60m technical carry score>=80; explicit setup-independent score30+30+20+10+10; no learned probability fed back into labels.
protocol.classifier: L2 regularized logistic regression; train-only standardization; rare/constant features disabled; coefficients learned, not hand-scored; probabilities require out-of-sample calibration
protocol.retrain: Every trading day using only prior windows; next-day OOS continuous account, old trade keeps original exit profile when daily model changes
protocol.selectionStress: Extra120CNY per round trip on same fills, separately from final full price/margin stress
protocol.historicalStatus: AU2612 history has already been inspected forv1; v2 daily walk-forward is retrospective protocol validation, not untouched prospective evidence. New dates after2026-11-06 are prospective.
protocol.informationPolicy: Current-vintage public FRED with DST/holiday-aware delayed availability proxies. No fabricated historical geopolitics/news sentiment. Missing and sparse factors remain disclosed.
protocol.priorVersionObserved: v2.0 lost28680CNY;v2.1 no candidates. Preserved. v2.2 fixes conflating confidence index with win probability and replaces average-win>=loss with positive expectancy/PF and bounded tail payout.
protocol.drawdownStopPolicy: Research safety assumption: planned risk must fit remaining15000CNY drawdown budget; on breach try exit and halt new entries for this version; gaps may exceed. No automatic restart.
protocol.eventRisk: FOMC/minutes2h before/after;CPI/NFP/PCE/GDP1h;next24h event or>12h nontrading gap forbids carry; original+revised dates where verified.
protocol.technicalFrequency: Causal daily completed/developing state and1/5/15/60m; everyminute patterns; stop/target everyminute; train-only correlation pruning>=.95
protocol.confidenceDefinition: 60+40*(p-pBE)/(1-pBE) clipped60-99 only for p>=pBE; pBE from train-only profile average win/loss. Index is economic signal strength, NOT probability. Probability separately calibrated.

specification.combinedSelection: Prior validation Wilson lower bound thenPnl/DD, intraday preference unchanged. Never select by next-day OOS results.
specification.knownPriorResults: Full53factorv2.2 lost12580CNY/47trades. This expanded same-history study is exploratory, not pristine prospective evidence.

status: Research only; inspect out-of-sample economics and calibration before calling any model reliable.
